stories.headline: The 30-Year Treasury Now Out-Yields Dividend Stocks by 2.2 Points. History Says What Followed the Last Time.
stories.body: Key PointsThe 30-year Treasury yield topped 5.33% on Tuesday, Aug. 18 -- its highest level since 2007 -- while the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF yields about 3.1%.

stories.headline: Fifth Third Backs Payload’s Embedded Payments Expansion
stories.body: Payload has secured a strategic investment led by Fifth Third to expand its embedded payments platform, Payload said in a Wednesday (Aug. 19) press release. Payload was founded in late 2019, processed its first payment in January 2020 and processed nearly $500 million in May alone, according to the release. The company has become a leading processor of earnest money deposits

stories.headline: Fifth bank fails in 2026 as drip of small-bank closures continues
stories.body: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank's failure is expected to cost the Deposit Insurance Fund $5.5 million. It is the fifth bank to fail this year, the most since 2023.
